pin_description: Halloween decorations UK shoppers love: hanging skeletons, pumpkin fairy lights, stretch spider web, a pumpkin carving kit, a girls' vampire costume and SFX face paint. intro: Halloween is creeping up fast - here are the highly-rated buys UK shoppers keep adding to their baskets for a spooky-but-easy set-up this year.

products.name: JOYIN 3 Pack Hanging Halloween Skeleton Ghosts
products.headline: Instant spooky porch in minutes
products.why: A pack of three hanging skeletons that go up in seconds on a porch, window or tree and set the scene for trick-or-treaters.

products.name: JOYIN Halloween Pumpkin String Lights
products.headline: Cosy glow for porch or mantel
products.why: Battery-powered 3D pumpkin and ghost lights that drape easily around a doorway, banister or shelf for a warm Halloween glow.

products.name: JOYIN 400 sqft Halloween Spider Web with Giant Spider
products.headline: Covers a porch or doorway fast
products.why: Stretches to cover a big area of bush, door frame or banister, and comes with a giant spider for extra drama.

products.name: Professional Pumpkin Carving Kit, 11 Piece
products.headline: Sharper, easier carving for all ages
products.why: Sturdy stainless steel tools and a carry case make carving faces into pumpkins much easier than a kitchen knife.

products.name: Spooktacular Creations Royal Vampire Costume for Girls
products.headline: A dress-up favourite for trick-or-treat
products.why: A deluxe vampiress dress-up set that regularly tops Halloween costume lists for girls and holds up well for party and trick-or-treat wear.

products.name: UCANBE 15 Colour Face & Body Paint Palette
products.headline: One palette, any Halloween look
